1–50 rows · 100 KB max. Required headers: payout_id, recipient, mint, amount, signature. Optional: not_before (ISO with timezone), reference.

One transaction may pay different wallets. Reusing the same signature + recipient + mint flags every affected row for allocation review.

Only signatures and network reads pass through our restricted server to Solana RPC. Expectations and CSV stay in this tab. RPC results may be cached in memory for 60 seconds; no durable payment records are stored.

RecipientMintAmountFinality

Exports are unsigned observations from one RPC, not independently authenticated certificates. Review context before marking a payout closed.

Know what the check proves.

Supported

Simple legacy SPL token transfers, including multiple recipients. Exact integer amount comparison, finalized lookup, optional reference and date rules.

Needs a person

Swaps, custom programs, Token-2022, payer identity, invoice authenticity and allocation across past reports. A transfer match alone never proves an obligation was settled.

Infrastructure

Public RPC can rate-limit or omit historical data. Errors produce no payment conclusion. Devnet tokens have no real payment value.
